_comment: THE PROPERTY REGISTRY. Ships with EXAMPLE ROWS ONLY — replace them with your own before the first run.
One object per owned property. /founder-pipeline:web-listings and /founder-pipeline:web-backlinks both read this file.
id: your own short identifier for the property. Used in folder names and log rows.
domain: the canonical site URL. Unique — this is the key you pass to the skill commands.
label: human-readable name.
brand_class: community | conference | personal-brand | services | marketplace-saas | app | product.
This is the ONLY field config/targets.json filters on (each target row's `applies_to` is a list of brand classes).
It drives which target categories get priority per web-backlinks/references/platform-matrix.md's weighting table.
active: true if the property is in the current registration push; false to keep it catalogued but unworked.
Registering a property as a PRODUCT on general launch-discovery platforms is a deliberate choice recorded here,
not something derived from brand_class — a community or a conference can be listed as a product if you want
that discovery surface. It does not extend to category-specific platforms or to the `review` category.
territory: which language/market surfaces this property can be submitted to. Gates the localize-before-register
rule (Law 4): 'worldwide' means English only; add a language code once localized pages exist and return 200
with correct hreflang; '<code>-native' means the property was built in that language and the gate is satisfied.
legal_entity: for institutional/business-catalog listings that require a registered company. null if the
property is not itself a legal entity — record which entity operates it in references/entity-pack.md instead.
notes: anything a listing pass needs to know before submitting.
Numbers used in generated listing copy MUST come from your single numbers source of truth, not from this file
and not from site copy — published site figures go stale silently.

properties.label: Example Community
properties.notes: EXAMPLE ROW — replace. A peer network / membership community. Priority categories: entity, event, institution, catalog, review. If localized pages exist for a second market, add that market to `territory` and the local-tier catalog rows unlock.

properties.label: Example Conference
properties.notes: EXAMPLE ROW — replace. An annual event. Priority categories: event (conference-data repos, developer-event calendars, CFP platforms), media, entity. Top-of-funnel — highest value from event-listing placements. Launch-day campaign work is out of scope for this skill; it only stages the profile.

properties.label: Example Practice
properties.legal_entity: <registered company name and number, or null>
properties.notes: EXAMPLE ROW — replace. A 1:1 practice under a named person. Priority categories: entity (person item, company-database person profile), vertical (practitioner directories), institution (the accreditation body for the discipline), speaker, review. Common open flag to record here: a marketplace profile strong enough to outrank the person's own site for their own name is an owner decision before submitting.

properties.label: Example Marketplace
properties.notes: EXAMPLE ROW — replace. A product with something a user can actually sign up for and use. Priority categories: startup-platform, review, vertical. Fit warning worth keeping: the B2B software-review sites only fit a genuine software product — a curated network or a services practice will sit there empty and read as abandoned. The consumer-review platform is usually the right review surface for those instead.
